tei:div.tei:p: "$ (447)༄༅// chos rgyal rigs ldan gtso bor gyur pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brgyud pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga rdo rje nyi ma'i snang ba chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakrā ya/ nyi rdul nor bur brtan cing gtsug tor du// byang sems zla ba gang bas srid zhi la// mi gnas dang po'i mgon gyur bar ma chad// byon pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud// gang la mchod na don che ba// de nyid mchod dang gsol 'debs thabs// rdo rje'i tshig rnams btus nas dgod// dad skal ldan rnams yi rang byos// de dang dben pa'i gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar rgyan gyis brgyan la/ thub dbang dus 'khor chos rgyal rigs ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku brnyan bris 'bul gyis mtshon/ bsod nams gsog pa'i rten gang 'byor bkram/ gung du stegs bu khebs bzang pos bkab pa'i steng du rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dri'i chu dang chang gis brlan pa la dbus su tshom bu che gcig dang g.yas g.yon chung gnyis/ de rgyab tshom bu nyer dgu/ de rgyab grangs ma nges pa bkod la khri'u'i khar bzhag /mdun tu 'bul gtor zlum po kha zas bzang dgus bskor ba dang nang mchod thod pa'i bdud rtsi bzhag /mchod pa bcu gnyis cha grangs 'dzom na phyogs bzhi ka dang cha gcig las med na shar du dri chab dang me tog /lhor spos dang mar me/ byang du zhal zas dang shing thog /nub tu sgeg mo ma dang bzhad ma mtshon pa'i na bza' dang me long*/ steng gi sgra ma'i ting shag sogs (449)rol mo gang rung dang*/ gar ma'i rdor dril lta bu/ 'og gi 'dod ma'i chos 'byung dang*/ glu ma mtshon byed pi waṃ rnams pa 'chol bar bsham/ de mdun chu bzhi'i snod phreng tshar dang*/ chu snod bya ma bum nye bar bsdogs// gzhan yang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ thabs shes kyi tshogs rdzas// mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o// chog dngos la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ skyabs sems yig rnying ltar na/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i phyir// bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/byang chub tu ni sems bskyed cing*// bsam pa rnam par dag par bgyid// lan gsum/ de nas/ rang skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur/ thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa shud+dho3 ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas byin (450) rlobs bgegs gsal ba ni/ lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// lus srul la sogs gang ci'ang rung*// lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje shugs// srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku yis ni// lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// rnam par brlag 'gyur gzhan tu min// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa hraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥ ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba ā ba ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka /bigh+nā bi na ya ka ā dī nāṃ da sha dig ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bdud sreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bsgrad/ tshams rngams dang po lo ma'i sgra bya/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥ swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi bsgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang snang gsal dang*/ zhal zas dam pa dag dang rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/ gos dang rgyan dang*/ ba dan dang bla bre la sogs pa dang glu dang gar dang me long dang dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dang*/

in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*// nang gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ (451)swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ badz+ra dhū paṃ= badz+ra dī paṃ= badz+ra ni wi d+yaṃ= badz+ra āk+ṣa taṃ= badz+ra lā s+yaṃ= badz+ra hā s+yaṃ= badz+ra wā d+yaṃ= badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ= badz+ra gī taṃ= oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ swā hā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe sarba dharma e ka pra dzñā bha ni swa bhā we/ sarba ā ka re sarba dharma pra bo dha ni sarba dharmā ṇa swa bhā wān pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i thog mar tshogs rten gsal gdab pa ni/ sa'i phyogs rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam las grub pa/ gzhi dang rgyan dang dbyibs dang bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa'i dbus su ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs kun tu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba// dbang po'i gzhu dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rang gi sems nyid kyis so sor snang ba gzhom du med cing rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med la phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i chos rgyal chen po zla ba bzang po sku mdog mthing sngon phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*// g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa// g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa gur gum gyi mdog can chos 'chad phyag rgyas ut+pa la'i sdong bu thugs kar bsnams pa'i me tog phrag gong g.yas g.yon du kha phye ba'i ze'u 'brur ral gri dang glegs bam gyis mtshan pa// g.yon du pad (452)zla'i gdan la rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po gangs ri'i mdangs ldan phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon thugs kar mtheb srin sbyar bas pad dkar rgyas pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/

gsum ka'ang zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan cing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du nyi ma'i 'od la sogs pa'i chos rgyal chen po bdun// bzang po rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i rigs ldan phyed skyong dum bur skyong ba dang bcas pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'o// de dag gi mdun tu rgyal dbang rang byung rdo rje/ dbu la zhwa nag gser mdangs can gsol ba// g.yas su kun mkhyen dol po pa chen po paṇa zhu brjid chags gsol ba/ de gnyis ka sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can// g.yon tu mkhas mchog bu ston chen po phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa gsum ka'ang rab byung gi cha byad can/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyogs mtshams rnams su tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ piṇ+ḍo ā tsar+ya/ dus 'khor zhabs che chung*/ grub chen sha ba ri/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ sa man+ta shrī/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra la sogs rgya gar gyi mkhas grub rnams dang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'bro lo shes rab grags pa/ ra lo chos rab/ dpal chen rgwa lo tsā/ chags lo chos rje dpal ba/ de dag so so nas nas brgyud pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bshad man ngag gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa// gzhan yang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams nam mkha' la sprin phung gtib pa ltar gsal ba'i/ gtso bo gsum gyi gnas (453bzhir rdo rje bzhi'i yi ges mtshan pa dang*/ thugs ka nas rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/

oṃ shrī māṃ gu ru kā la tsakra sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya ā sa na s+t+waṃ/ de nas bsags sbyong yan lag bdun rim par bya ba la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma ste de yis 'khyud/ skye 'jigs spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan bzhad pa la sogs bde ba spangs/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi skyed mdzad sku gsum dag dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnam par dag pa srid pa gsum gyis mchod// de nyid gcig pu sku yis rab tu dbye bas rnam pa bcu drug srid med srid par gnas// shes dang shes bya gcig gyur rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig yan lag rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi// bden don byang chub sems ni rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gyur dus kyi 'khor lo la (454)phyag 'tshal// kun mkhyen ye shes sku ni rgyal ba'i bdag po'i lhan cig skyes dang de bzhin chos kyi sku// longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku yang nyin byed sku dang pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan// rnam par thar dang sku gsung thugs chags srid 'das 'byor pa rnal 'byor dag pa shes rab dang*// thabs ni gnyis med gang zhig lha mi lha min gyis bstod dang po'i sangs rgyas de la 'dud// gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid ni// de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom te// mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pas steng du ni// lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang*// khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*// khyod ni 'ga' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do// khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter// srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman// lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang*// gzi brjid zlas byin lha yi dbang phyug dang*// sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te// chos rgyal chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang*// bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang*// phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*// nyi ma grags pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu bzang po rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang*// rgyal bar dka' dang nyi ma sna tshogs gzugs// (455)zla 'od mtha' yas sa skyong dpal skyong dang*// seng ge rnam gnon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge dang*// dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam par rgyal// drag po 'khor lo can te nyi shu lnga// sa gzhi rdzogs par skyong la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyong ba dang*/

'od srung la sogs dum bur skyong ba brgyad// rigs kun gcig tu byed pa gsang sngags kyi// rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus zhabs gnyis dang na len+d+ra pa dang*// zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang*// lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang*// grub chen yu mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang*// sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang*// chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang*// kun spang chos rje rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon chos rje dang*// grub chen kun blo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha' chos skyong dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*// rje btsun grol mchog zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lung rig rgya mtsho kun dga' snying po dang*// rin chen rgya mtsho blo gros rnam par rgyal// ngag dbang phrin las kun bzang dbang po dang*// tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa'i nyin byed phrin las rnam par rgyal// pad+ma nyin byed dbang po la sogs pa// 'bro lugs gtsor gyur sgrub ba'i bka' babs pa// brgyud 'dzin skyes chen rnams la phyag= /tsi lus pa dang piṇ+ḍo ā tsar+ya// dus zhabs che chung bo dhi bha dra dang*// tsa mi sangs rgyas grags (456)dang rgwa lo tsā// khams pa a seng rnams la= /se lo gzhon tshul dar 'od bkra shis mtshan// sangs rgyas rdo rje mkhas grub o rgyan pa// kun dga' don grub rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs// don grub 'od zer rnams la= /mañdzu kir+t+ti sa man+ta shrī// rā lo chos rab ye shes seng ge ba// 'bum seng rnam rgyal rdo rje sher seng dang*// dpal ldan seng ge rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rgyal mtshan bu ston rin chen grub// bsod nams rgyal mtshan rin chen rnam rgyal sogs// rā lugs gtsor gyur bshad pa'i bka' babs pa// brgyud 'dzin skyes chen rnams la=

/paṇa chen shākya shrī dang bi bhū ti// dpyal lo chos bzang chag lo dgra bcom pa// sa skya paṇa chen go lung gzhon nu dpal// mar ston g.yang 'bar rnams la= /rong gling steng pa she'u lo tsa ba// ldi ri ra bying ba ri lo tsā dang*// man lung gu ru ko brag bsod rgyal mtshan// ngo mtshar skyes mchog rnams la= /grub pa'i dbang phyug ri khrod mgon po dang*// nags kyi rin chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde// 'gos lo gzhon nu spyan snga chos grags sogs// nye brgyud bka' babs rnams la= /sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// tshad med rnam thar chos kyi phung po dang*// dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la= /dpal ldan rgyu skar chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas byang chub sems// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas rnams la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par sprul nas ni// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis (457)phyag 'tshal lo//

de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la chu bzhi dang nyer spyod ni/ rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu gter ni// rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs// zhal gyi rnyogs pa'i dri sel yon chab 'di// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka ra ār+thaṃ āñtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ// rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i= rab dwangs kha dog= /zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri sel spos kyi chu// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas = /oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ār+thaṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ tshig rkang dang po gnyis dang phyi ma 'dra ba'o// rnam dag ye shes= /rab dwangs kha dog= /kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung 'di// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes= /oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ār+thaṃ prok+ṣacaṃ ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rnam dag ye shes= rab dwangs kha dog= yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+ghaṃ'i rgyun// bla ma rgyal ba= oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ār+thaṃ ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas chu bzhi phul/ chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu gnyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams// rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di// bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// oṃ shrī māṃ gu ru kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu gnyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs// bzhes nas bdag la= badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu gnyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams// rdo rje bdug spos bla na med// bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ chos rgyal rigs ldan= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje sgron ma 'od rab 'bar// bzhes nas= /badz+ra dī paṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan= /rtsa brgyud bla (458)ma'i= /rdo rje zhal zas ro mchog ldan// bzhes nas=

/badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu gnyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams// rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// badz+ra āk+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje sgeg mo'i mchod pa ni// bzhes nas= /badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa 'di// bzhes nas= /badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po// bzhes nas= /badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sum= /rtsa brgyud= /rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di// bzhes nas= /badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i// rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan// bzhes nas= /badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /chos rgyal rigs ldan= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= /rdo rje 'dod pa'i mchod pa mchog /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes rig ma bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ gos thung 'bul la/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog / mchod pa bcu gsum ni/ rab 'bar nor bu rin chen in+d+ra rnyil/ gser dngul la sogs rin chen me tog dang*// reg na bde ba rnam mang gos kyi tshogs// tsan+dan la sogs dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab// dri zhim bdug spos bsreg pa'i sprin tshogs dang*// rtsi bcud 'bru mar dang bcas sgron me'i tshogs// grags stong gnyis su med pa dril bu'i sgra// gsal snang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long dang*// lha rdzas bra bre nam mkha'i tshad 'jal byed// rnam mang (459)'bras bu sna tshogs bcud ster zhing*// lhab lhub g.yo ba ba dan rnam lnga'i tshogs// 'jo sgeg rnams 'gyur spro ba'i gar mkhan dang*// sgra snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa ste// bcu gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba rab 'gags nas// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog

/ mchod pa rnam bcu ni/ rab dwangs yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang*// 'o chab me tog bcas pa'i mchod yon bzang*// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang mkha' khyab dang*// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang*// ut+pal pad+ma la sogs me tog bkra// ma nyams sa hā ra'i 'bras bu smin// sman mchog dbang po la sogs 'bru sna tshogs// nyi zla nor bu la sogs snang gsal tshogs// bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i lha bshos dang*// pañtsa li kā lha yi gos kyi mchog /mchod pa rnam bcu phul bas sa bcu thob// dkyil 'khor rnam bcu sgrib bral thob par shog /bkra shis rtags brgyad ni// ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la// bkra shis dpal be'u g.yu drung 'khyil// dge ba'i don tu mnga' ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang 'bul bar bgyi// ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la// gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can// tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar sngon gyi= /'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i// pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar sngon gyi= /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi// chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar// de bzhin= /ji ltar= /gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can// phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// ji ltar= /re ba thams cad (460)rdzogs mdzad pa'i// bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar// de bzhin= /ji ltar= /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi// 'bud dung g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar= /na bza' gser gyi nya ris can// phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ rgyal srid rdzas brgyad mkho ba'i yo byad sna tshogs 'bul ba ni/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gser gyi 'khor lo dang*// dgos 'dod ma lus stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor// gzugs mdzes skyon kun bral ba btsun mo'i mchog

/bang mdzod ma lus 'gengs byed blon po'i phul// yid 'ong stobs ldan glang po'i bdag po dang*// cang shes sprin gyi shugs can rmad byung rta// rgol ba kun 'joms khyim bdag dpa' bo che// de ltar rin chen bdun gyis dkyil 'khor mchod// dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang*// g.yas 'khyil chos sgra mi zad sgrog pa'i dung*// dug gsum nyon mongs 'joms pa'i gi haṃ dang*// rtsi bcud snying po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zho// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i li khri'i rdzas// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub dur ba'i rtsa// don mchog bla med sgrub pa'i bil ba'i 'bras// bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms yungs dkar te// rgyal bas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad po// phul bas 'gro la dge legs 'phel bar shog /nyon mongs ma lus gcod pa'i stag lpags dang*// sgrib pa kun bral glang chen lpags pa'i gos// 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal mnyes byed pa// sna tshogs na bza'i mchod pa dbul bar bgyi// dbang sngon karke ta na chu shel dang*// pad dmar ma ra ta ka mu tig dang*// dzam bu chu bo'i gser dang dngul la sogs// (461)bza' dang bca' ba rnam pa du ma dang*// rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang*// ljon shing la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bsod nams spel phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// ral gri khang pa lpags pa skyed mos tshal// mal cha gos dang mchil l+h+wam rin po che// pad+ma can sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad// sna tshogs rin chen las grub khang bzang dang*// dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po dang*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang rin chen ri bo sogs// mchod sprin rgya mtshos bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mchod/ mchod pa bcu gnyis kyi nges don dran pas mchod pa ni/ kun+da rab tu khyab byed dri bzang dang*// rnam dag nyi mas dag byed me tog phreng*// don dam dbyings kyi bla ma lha la 'bul// 'gro bas rnam dag zla nyi thob par shog

/gtum mo 'bar bas kun rtog bsregs pa'i spos// snying nang gzhom med 'bar ba'i snang gsal tshogs// don dam dbyings kyi= /spros bral ye shes snang ba thob par shog /'dod yon gzhan mchog bdud rtsi zhal zas lnga// thig le nor bur bcings pa'i ma nyams 'bru// don dam dbyings kyi= /stong pa'i gzugs kyis byang sems 'ching bar shog /ma dag gnas gyur ye shes sgeg mo'i lus// las rlung dhū tir thim pas bzhad sgra'i dbyangs// don dam dbyings kyi= /rdo rje'i sku dang bcu gnyis sa thob shog /gzhom med nā da'i rol mo sil snyan mchog /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i rol pa bde ba'i gar// don dam dbyings kyi= /grags stong sgra dang sgyu rtsal mchog thob shog /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho chos nyid rdo rje'i glu// mi 'gyur bde sgrub phyag chen 'dod pa mo// don dam dbyings kyi bla ma lha la 'bul// rdo rje'i gsung dang mi 'gyur bde thob shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa (462)mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum la sogs pa ci rig par brjod/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba la/ chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// 'phags bod dus zhabs che rnams gtsor gyur pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul// 'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la// mchog tu rol pas bde chen thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa de ba ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ na mo na maḥ gtor ma gong gi sngags tshan bzhis byin rlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di rnams kyang*// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par/

zhes 'bul/ mkha' 'gro gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ a kā taṃ/ da dā ma he/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho// ī daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa tu/ khā da tu/ pa bin tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ka /sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣa ā war na/ gup+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ s+thā naṃ/ t+yak+t+wa/ bā h+ya maṇ+ḍal bhū myāṃ tiṣ+ṭhan+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas 'bul/ de nas bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ srid 'gro nyams nga byis pa'i blo yis ni// shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang*// 'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga ba// lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis// bdag gi sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so// byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang*// sdig pa'i grogs dang 'phrad pa nyam nga dang*// srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga dang*// zhe sdang gti mug mun pa nyam nga dang*// ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga (463)dang*// bsod nams bsgrub pa nyam nga dag gis kyang*// rgyal ba yang dag mngon sum mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/

lam bsnyen pa ni/ byang chub mchog gi sems dang ni// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang*// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i// rtsa ba bsten bgyi tshogs gsum phyir// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang ni// smon lam stobs dang ye shes kyi// pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs par bgyi// byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*// btang snyoms rnams la gnas bgyi zhing*// sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*// don spyod pa dang don mthun spyad// srog gcod ma byin gzhan gyi bud med dang*// rdzun dang tshig rtsub rnams dang phra ma dang*// 'khyal par gyur pa'i tshig dang brnab sems dang*// gnod sems lta ba ngan pa rnam par spang*// 'gyod dang gnyid rmugs rgod dang the tshom ste// sgrib pa lnga po yongs su spang bgyi zhing*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal gyi// nyon mongs bzhi rnams bdag gis kun tu spang*// 'dod (464)dang srid pa ma rig lta ba yi// zag pa bzhi yang yongs su spang bgyi'o// sdom pa bzung ba ni// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// (465)dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ lan gsum bya/ de nas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ chos rje kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung byin rlabs can mang du bzhugs pa las rgyal ba rigs bzhi'i gsol 'debs ni/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bho dhi sa twe bh+yo na mo na maḥ rgyal ba sku bzhi'i rang bzhin dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// brtse ba chen pos dus thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol// sor sdud bsam gtan bsnyen pa'i yan lag gis// sad pa'i gnas skabs spangs nas sad pa gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i sad pa'i sna tshogs gzugs// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// srog rtsol 'dzin pa nyer bsgrub yan lag gis// rmi lam gnas skabs spangs nas rmi lam gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i rmi lam gzhom med sgra// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// rjes su dran pa bsgrub pa'i yan lag gis// gnyid 'thug gnas skabs spangs nas gnyid 'thug gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i gnyid 'thug bsam du med// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ting 'dzin yan lag bsgrub pa chen po yis// chags pa'i gnas skabs spangs nas chags pa gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i chags pa 'gyur med bde// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'du mi byed pa'i rnam thar snying rje yis// lus kyi bya ba spangs nas lus gzhan mchog /bde gshegs snying po'i lus mchog rdo rje'i sku/ mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// smon pa med pa'i rnam thar dga' ba yis// ngag gi bya ba spangs nas ngag gzhan mchog

/bde (466)gshegs snying po'i ngag mchog rdo rje'i gsung*// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mtshan ma med pa'i rnam thar byams pa yis// sems kyi bya ba spangs nas sems gzhan mchog /bde gshegs snying po'i sems mchog rdo rje'i thugs// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// stong pa nyid kyi rnam thar btang snyoms kyis// chags pa'i bya ba spangs nas chags pa gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i chags pa rdo rje'i bde// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dga' ba'i dga' ba bum pa'i dbang mchog gis// lus kyi thig le 'gags nas thig le gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i thig le sprul pa'i sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mchog dga'i dga' ba gsang ba'i dbang mchog gis// ngag gi thig le 'gags nas thig le gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i thig le longs spyod sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// khyad par dga' ba gsum pa'i dbang mchog gis// sems kyi thig le 'gags nas thig le gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i thig le chos kyi sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi pa'i dbang mchog gis// chags pa'i thig le 'gags nas thig le gzhan// bde gshegs snying po'i thig le lhan skyes sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// sor sdud bsam gtan dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor gyis// lus kyi sgrib pa phung po'i bdud bcom nas// dam tshig sems dpa' pad 'dab yangs pa'i spyan// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// srog rtsol 'dzin pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor (467)gyis// ngag gi sgrib pa nyon mongs bdud bcom nas// sems dpa' chen po nyin mor byed pa'i sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// rjes dran yan lag chos kyi rnal 'byor gyis// sems kyi sgrib pa 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas// byang chub sems dpa' ye shes chen po'i sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ting 'dzin yan lag dag pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// ma rig sgrib pa lha yi bdud bcom nas// rdo rje sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// lus kyi longs spyod kun la mi ltos par// lus la chags pa lus kyi nyes bcom nas// dri bral 'bras bu rnam pa kun mkhyen sku// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ngag gi longs spyod kun la mi ltos par// ngag la chags pa ngag gi nyes bcom nas// skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu lam mkhyen nyid// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// yid kyi longs spyod kun la mi ltos par// sems la chags pa sems kyi nyes bcom nas// rnam smin 'bras bu lam gyi rnam mkhyen nyid// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'pho ba'i longs spyod kun la mi ltos par// 'pho la chags pas 'pho ba'i nyes bcom nas// rgyu mthun 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa nyid// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// oṃ yig rnam pa sna tshogs skad cig mas// spyi bo'i 'khor lo dag pa'i he ru ka

/sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par byang chub pa// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// āḥyig rnam par smin pa'i skad cig mas// mgrin pa'i 'khor (468)lo dag pa'i he ru ka /rnam pa nyi shus mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// hūm̐ yig rnam par nyid pa'i skad cig mas// snying kha'i 'khor lo dag pa'i he ru ka /rnam pa lnga yis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mngon sum sten mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// hoḥyig mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig mas// lte ba'i 'khor lo dag pa'i he ru ka /skad cig gcig gi mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// gdan bzhi bden bzhi de nyid bzhi la sogs// rigs bzhi'i 'khor lo dkyil 'khor bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas sras bcas kun la phyag 'tshal mchod// sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs gsol 'debs// lus 'bul skyabs mchi byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// dge ba gang bsags sku bzhi thob phyir sngo/

zhes dang*/ gzhan yang sbyor drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs ci nus kyis gsol ba btab/ 'dod don zhu ba ni/ lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor bcad// nyams 'od gsal rtags bcu mngon gyur nas// lam sor sdud 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin can bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs= /yid rlung sems ngag rnams mi g.yo zhing*// nyams shes rab tog dpyod dga' bde 'phel// lam bsam gtan 'byongs par byin gyis= /pha drin can= /'dren mchog= /lha bde gshegs= /rtsa ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar tshud// nyams gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu// lam (469)srog rtsol 'byong par byin= /pha drin can= /'dren mchog= /lha bde gshegs= /khams 'dzag med thig le dbral bar brten// nyams zhu bde 'gyur me rgyud la skyes// lam 'dzin pa 'byongs par byin= /pha drin chen= /'dren mchog= /lha bde= /lus rtsa 'dab bde chen thig les gang*// nyams phyag rgya gsum la mnga' brnyes pas// lam rjes dran 'byongs= /pha drin can= /'dren mchog= /lha bde gshegs= /rtsa 'khor lo drug po bde bas gang*// nyams spros pa med la dbang 'byor ba'i// lam ting 'dzin 'byongs par= /pha drin chen= /'dren mchog= /lha bde gshegs= /lus byed bcings gnad dang ma bral zhing*// chos ma nor man ngag zab mo yis// lam sbyor drug 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// 'dren mchog yab sras rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos rje kun mkhyen pa'i gsung sogs 'dod gsol gzhan yang spro na bya// de nas tshogs mchod phul na/ tshogs rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa// de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems// shar du i las rkang mar// lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du u las dri chu/ nub tu l̥ las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su lā las glang po che'i sha /dbang ldan tu ū las ba glang gi sha /bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha /me mtshams (470)su ī las khyi'i sha /dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha /rlung g.yos me spar rdzas rnams zhu// lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dharma su bi shud+dha swa bhā wa sarba dharmā nra bi sho dha ya swā hā// lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur// oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharmā nra pra bo dha ya swā hā// lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgrag can gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sarba dharmā dī pa ka sarba dharmā nra pra dī pa ya swā hā// mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta kar sarba dharmā na badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ na mo// thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa// mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/

byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams= /phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams= /dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra= /oṃ mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*// mos (471)gus gzhom med pho brang na// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rnam dag bde chen 'gyur med dngos// bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du// dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems// mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid// rnam 'phrul sogs rkang pa drug kun la 'gres/ spros bral dag pa e yig dbyings// rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' spyod nas// 'khor lo'i bdag mo sna tshogs yum// dbyings phyug shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam 'phrul= /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul mchog /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor bcas dang*// rtsod ldan dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang*// brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kun kyang*// rnam 'phrul= /gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa// sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha// gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// phyag brnyan po nya 'byung po'i tshogs// rnam 'phrul= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khra la la// rol mo mang po di ri ri// klu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne rjen// gtad med rig pa sa la la// brjod med dbyings su tha la la// bde ba chen po khri li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la (472)dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar cad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par rol/

de nas phud dang po bcad la/ gtor ma la yang cung zad sgron/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa dang*// phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang rgu rnams// bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// zhes 'bul/ de nas las rdor gyis lag g.yon pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi bzung*// g.yas rtse gsum gyis phyag rgyas bkab te/ kye/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du rol// zhes drangs/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes blangs/ slar yang tshogs rdzas gzhan rnams la bsre/ yang bud gcig bcad de/ phyed sngar gyi phud dang bsre/ phyed lhag gtor la bsre ba'i phyir logs su bzhag go / zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di rnams kyang*// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*// mchod yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul// 'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la// mchog tu rol bas bde chen thob par shog /dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun kyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig / de nas so so'i phud bcad nas/ (473)oṃ āḥgu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥbadz+ra nai wid+ya hūm̐/ chang bu gnyis pa byas/ oṃ ha ri ti piṇ+ḍa ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ yang chang bu gsum pa byas la/ oṃ sarba dū tī ke /a grā gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa gsal btab la so sor longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣu dhak+ṣa bhak+ṣu swā hā/ lan gsum/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir btang*/ drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ de nas rdo rje'i glu blangs bzhi/ dril bu'i sgra dang bcas/ kol+la i re ṭaṭha a bol+la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ta ho badz+dza a/ ka ru ṇi ki a i ṇa ro lā/ tā hi ba la khādz+dza ī/ gā ḍa ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñtsa ra sa ni a i/ du dhu ra badz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma ka ts+tshu ri sih+la/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la in+dha na sā liṃ dzaḥ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phre kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha ṇ+ṇa ma ni a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍā bi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā ba pa ṇi a i/ ma la a tsa kun+tu ru ba ḍā i/ ḍi ṇa ḍi ma ta hi na badz+dza a i/ zhes brjod/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma mig la sogs pa dang*// bsregs pas ring bong can haṃ 'dzag /ces brjod cing don bsgom// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus te 'bul zhing phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dbang blang ba bcas chos rje kun mkhyen (474) chen po'i gsung las byung ba ni/ me 'gyur yid 'ong mtshan dpes legs spras// 'gag med tshangs dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs mdzad// 'khrul med phyag rgya che la gnas pa'i// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal// sor sdud la sogs sbyong byed drug gis// phung po la sogs sbyang bya drug drug

/legs par sbyangs pa'i bde gshegs so drug /gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal// lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs// mchod pa'i sprin dpung dpag tu med pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ci bzhin// bdag yid dang bas mchod par 'bul lo// lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i// sdig pa'i tshogs kun mthol lo bshags so// dge la yi rang chos 'khor skor mdzod// rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so// tshogs gsum mthar phyin bcu gnyis lam bgrod// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtso bo// sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /gnyis med ye shes rtse gcig bsgoms pas// gnyis snang tshogs brgyad gnas gyur thob pa'i// ye shes lnga ldan dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin bcu gnyis dbang gis// skal ldan gdul bya smin grol mdzad pa'i// bla ma kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /khyod phung rigs drug skye mched sras brgyad// phyag zhabs la sogs khro bo'i tshogs kun// yi dam kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /don gnyis mthar byin chos sku'i ngo bo// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzod// (475)sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /don dam brjod bral rnam byang bden pas// gsung rab glegs bam rnam par ston mdzad// dam chos kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /rigs grol gnyis ldan sa bcu'i mnga' bdag /'gro ba'i mgon skyabs bshes gnyen dam pa// dge 'dun kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /dmigs med snying rje bde chen ngo bo// thabs kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad// chos skyong kun 'dus dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig

/zhi rgyas dbang drag las la mnga' brnyes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster mdzad// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos kun la// 'chad rtsod rtsom gyis log rtog sel mdzad// ma rig mun sel dpal ldan bla mar// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shig /deng nas bdag ni bla ma khyed dang*// lus dang grib ma lta bur 'grogs te// zab don man ngag bdud rtsi 'thung bar// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ma dag log pa'i 'tsho ba spangs nas// bdud rtsi lce sbyor nyams su blangs te// zas gos sogs la ltos pa med par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i don la// rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgrubs par byas nas// tshe 'di nyid la phyag chen thob par// dpal (476)ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig / bzod gsol ni/ bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur pas// ma rig nyes pa'i chags rnams gang bgyis pa// brtse ldan khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags par gyi// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol// ces dang yig brgya brjod/ thugs rje che ldan bla ma dkon mchog rnams// dbang bzhi bskur la bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dri ma bzhi dag lam bzhi 'byong ba dang*// sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'thob par mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas gtso bo la thim// gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gnas bzhir rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrnams kyis mtshan bar gyur// dpral ba'i oṃ las oṃ yig dkar po// rang gi lus kyi dpral bar zhugs shing*// de la brten nas bum dbang thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /lus dang sad pa'i sgrib pa dag nas// dga' ba'i dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas// sku yi rdo rje sprul sku thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig

/mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥyig dmar po// rang gi lus kyi mgrin par zhugs shing*// de la brten nas gsang dbang thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /ngag dang rmi lam sgrib pa dag nas// mchog gi dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas// gsung gi rdo rje longs sku thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig nag po// rang gi lus kyi snying khar zhugs shing*// de la (477)brten nas gsang dbang thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /yid dang gnyid 'thug sgrib pa dag nas// khyad par dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas// thugs kyi rdo rje chos sku thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /lte ba'i hoḥlas hoḥyig ser po// rang gi lus kyi lte bar zhugs shing*// de la brten nas bzhi dbang thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /chags pa'i bag chags dri ma dag nas// lhan skyes dga' bzhi nyams su myong bas// ye shes rdo rje bde stong thob par// dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs shig /spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas// rang gi lus la gnyis med thim zhing*// snying kha'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus su// brtan par bzhugs nas byin gyis rlobs shig /

ces bla ma'i gsang ba gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog /smon lam gdab pa ni/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyi lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgom ste// 'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas// lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtugs shing*// dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin tu mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /ji ltar sangs rgyas mthu yis bdag gis lta ba ni// zhi gyur de bzhin mi rnams la ni 'gyur bar shog /thams cad du ni du ba'i lam la brten pa yi// sems ni rgyal ba'i thugs rje chen por 'gyur bar shog /(478)dus 'khor gsang ba legs rtogs dam tshig yongs ldan zhing*// 'di ston bla ma'i rjes 'brang rdo rje spun la sogs// phan tshun legs par smra zhing mkhon tu mi 'dzin dang*// dam tshig rdo rje gleng slong dal gyis gnas par shog /ma rung dam bral ngan pa'i lam byed cing*// rnal 'byor ched du mi gnyer skye bo gang*// de dang mi 'grogs de yis mi mthong dang*// rang sdug bla ma rdo rje mchod par shog /rtsod ldan dus su gsang chen ston byed dang*// mu stegs skye bo ngan pa'i lta 'joms shing*// gang de'i lta ba dbyings nas 'don byed pa'i// de dag 'dul ba'i ded dpon de byed shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang*// zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang*// go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bza' zhing*// mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog

/skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// dpal ldan (479)bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog / shis brjod ni/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi shis tshig gis thog drangs te ji ltar 'os pa'i tshig phreng rgyas par spel la me tog gi char bsnyil ba sogs bya'o// 'di ltar mchod pa'i byin rlabs shugs chen pos// nyi khri chig stong 'pho ba'i dbugs bkag te// de snyed mi 'gyur bde ba'i gnas pa thob// e waṃ zung 'jug mchog dngos myur 'grub shog /ces pa'ang sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi ring lugs gces pa bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i rnal 'byor la nye par mkho pa'i zur 'debs kyi tshul du 'du gsum gyi rnal 'byor spyod par karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas su 'bod pas kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas sogs byin rlabs can gyi tshig tshogs rnams las gzhir blangs te dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga laṃ//
